name: naman
taste_notes: Likes slow-burn, morally ambiguous thrillers, grounded sci-fi that runs on ideas rather than spectacle, and restrained character-driven indie drama. Dislikes formulaic action, jump-scare horror, padded 10-episode series that should have been films, loud rom-coms, and anything needing a recap to follow. Watches 2-3 titles a week, so every pick has to earn its slot.
